name: Sarah Johnson
tone: Heartfelt and emotional with touches of humor
keyPoints: How we met in college during freshman orientation
Our road trip across the country after graduation
Her unwavering support during my difficult times
The moment I knew she found her soulmate
specialMoments: I remember the day Sarah called me crying tears of joy to tell me about the proposal. She said 'He's the one, Em. He's really the one.' I had never heard her so happy. From that moment, I knew this day would be magical.
customDetails: Sarah loves to laugh and doesn't take herself too seriously. The groom, Michael, is a software engineer who swept her off her feet with his kindness and terrible dad jokes. They have a golden retriever named Biscuit who was their 'practice baby'. Please incorporate their love for travel and adventure - they've visited 15 countries together.
